The '''Mudflats''' were marshes on the [[Naboo/Legends|Nabooian]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Rori/Legends|Rori]]. They were located between the [[Asworal Everglades]] and the [[Narmle Bog]].<ref name="SWG" />

{{Loc-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Mudflats are one of many designated planetary regions in the [[Wikipedia:MMORPG|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''.<ref name="SWG" />
